workload: sequential client; not concurrency-12 contract workload
limitations: Service hides both quota and transient provider exceptions behind 503. Exact cause of the 18 failures is unverified.
Generator returned in X-Generator response header; original driver incorrectly read JSON generator field, so use service log for provenance.
Latency file includes successful first-pass requests only; no end-to-end recovery timing.
Failed INSUFFICIENT calls lose usage accounting; reported successful generation costs are incomplete.
Global llm.last_error is shared across threads, so concurrency-12 retry decisions need thread-safety correction and tests.
default_activation: none; retry and date flags remain off
comparison_limits: Single runs differ in policy, date, service transport behavior and judge outputs; not controlled causal evidence.
